title: PRESENCE
alt_text: A young woman with dark curly hair and a charcoal sweater looks toward the camera against a black background. A sculpted shell of her face stands on a post in a black marble hall veined with gold while she walks away behind it. The hall opens onto light, then into a warm library with a spiral stair and brass lamps, where she walks to a tall window over green trees. It ends on her face again.

location.name: Great Sphinx of Giza
location.why: Seen by everyone for millennia, still not truly known. Familiarity hides distance.

youtube.title: 029 | PRESENCE 🎭 #philosophy #motivation
youtube.description:
You can see someone every day and mistake it for knowing them.

You know their voice. Their laugh. The way they cross a room.
Familiarity hides distance well.

What someone lets you see, and who they are when no one is watching, are not always the same.

Presence is not access.

—
